description:
Treasure Valley Electric is a commercial electrical contracting company based in the Treasure Valley, Idaho area. We make videos for electricians and tradespeople who want to get better at the business side of running a company — not just the craft.
Most electricians are great at their trade. Running a profitable business is a different skill entirely. We talk about the things that actually matter: pricing your work correctly, tracking change orders, understanding your real labor rate, and building systems so money stops slipping through the cracks.
We also get into the tools we use every day on commercial jobs, day in the life content from real job sites, and hands-on technical skills like conduit bending, wire pulling, and commercial installations.
If you're an electrician who's already in business and wondering why the money doesn't add up — this channel is for you.
New videos every week. Subscribe so you don't miss them.
